content.short: Network that speeds up how blocks and data spread between blockchain nodes.
content.description: Optimum uses random linear network coding (RLNC) to replace the redundant gossip most blockchains use to pass blocks around. It reports 6 to 20 times faster block and blob delivery and 90 to 95% less bandwidth, without any change to a chain's consensus rules. It is working with Ethereum validators first, with 40 testnet partners and $24 billion of staked ETH connected.
content.meta: Optimum speeds up block propagation 6 to 20x and cuts validator bandwidth by up to 95% using network coding.
